name: Chile
dek: Quinta Normal, Santiago, WMO 85577. A long country; this is the capital.
paragraphs: The reference station is Quinta Normal Santiago, WMO 85577, height 520 m. Pudahuel, the airport file, prints no monthly values for temperature or precipitation in this collection, so it was not used. January is midsummer. No tourism-office tipping page was opened on this pass.

The highest average high in the table is 30.4 °C, in January. The lowest average low is 3.8 °C, in July. The wettest month by the precipitation column is June, at 80.4 mm, and the driest is January, at 0.6 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Quinta Normal Santiago, WMO 85577. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Pudahuel (85574) prints number-of-years rows but no monthly values, so it was not used.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Quinta Normal Santiago (85577)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and L, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Chile at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 116 of the Traffic Law, in the consolidated text of DFL 1 of 2007 published by the Library of the National Congress, says that on public roads vehicles must travel on the right half of the carriageway, with exceptions such as overtaking.
driving.sourceTitle: Ley de Tránsito (DFL 1, 2007), artículo 116, BCN Ley Chile

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Chile, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the Chilean Peso, code CLP, for Chile. It also lists Unidad de Fomento, code CLF, a unit of account, which is not printed as the currency.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.value: America/Santiago for most of Chile; 4 zones in all
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Chile four rows: America/Santiago, commented most of Chile; America/Coyhaique for the Aysén Region; America/Punta_Arenas for the Magallanes Region; and Pacific/Easter for Easter Island.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Chile, consular services
entry.note: The foreign ministry's consular services site. We do not restate a visa rule.
